basics.name: Tim Cotten
basics.label: Founder, AI Engineer, Researcher, and Adjunct Instructor
basics.summary: Founder, engineer, and researcher focused on autonomous AI agents, decentralized systems, agent economies, and game-inspired AI design. Founder & CEO of Scrypted. Adjunct Instructor at George Mason University teaching Generative AI in Game Development. Formerly built AI systems for virtual economies in EA online worlds.

work.name: Scrypted

highlights: Built a community of 10k+ token holders
Built and launched Delula as a consumer-facing proof of an autonomous business
